ENGLISH: Ayoub: No Mariam, I want to understand this fully. So…
We agree that knowledge of all things \n is the ultimate goal for you men of science right?
We rarely have the opportunity to talk like this \n you and I Nastulus, so please, tell me.
Nastulus: Yes, I- I thought this too when I was younger, but…
To be honest, Ayoub, this could not be further \n from the truth.
Ayoub: How could it not be your goal?
Nastulus: What is knowledge without meaning?
Ayoub, under our imam you have dedicated your life to meaning,
I have dedicated mine to knowledge, \n but is this not wrong?
Shouldn’t the scientist and the philosopher \n work hand in hand?
Ayoub : All of your questions have already been answered \n old man.
How long has it been since you last opened the holy Quran?
Ayoub: No no no. Let him answer.
